payload.title: First slice: swap the Vote island on stories for the core Vote block
payload.description:
What: the smallest end-to-end swap. One block (Vote on story pages, hook line ~2296) placed from layout data; Shipped's page looks and behaves as before; the dimensions and subject types stay in papyrus.config.ts and web/scoring.json (tests/test_hooks.py keeps the pairs in sync). Needs Papyrus PPY-57f6d2 (islands as blocks).
Acceptance:
Scenario: A story page shows the same vote control
  Given the Vote block is placed by configuration
  When a story page renders
  Then the control matches the previous markup in the golden render and the hook no longer emits it
Scenario: A reader's vote still counts once
  Given a signed-in reader votes on a story
  Then one vote is recorded and the tally updates after the next snapshot
